entries.5d5305370b9774f4: It is a resource-recycling business model that collects scrap containing precious metals, rare metals and other materials, recovers and refines gold, silver and platinum-group metals, and sells them as bullion products.
entries.796cff5a771d2a08: This is the core business, accounting for almost all of the Group's revenue (external revenue of ¥569,863 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026). In Japan, Asahi Pretec Corp. and Asahi Metal Fine Co., Ltd. collect, separate and refine scrap and other materials containing precious metals and rare metals, gathered from fields such as electronic materials, dental materials, jewelry and automotive catalysts, at plants in various locations, and sell them as high-purity bullion products and other products. They also perform precious metal stripping and precision cleaning of parts of manufacturing machinery and equipment used by semiconductor and electronic component manufacturers and others. Overseas, the Group refines and processes precious metals, mainly gold and silver, in the United States and Canada, operates a precious metals warehousing business in the United States, and advances precious metal recycling in Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand and India.
entries.806f3bd82478693d: It has a system in which it collects materials from a broad range of fields, including electronic materials, dental materials, jewelry and automotive catalysts, and recovers and refines them at its domestic plants and North American refining sites for sale. In North America, it has the largest refining capacity in the region, and it is also engaged in precious metal warehousing and trading, which is a distinguishing feature.
